title: Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Kress named interim
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: Fox Business reports Huang said on Tue 17 Nov he would return if the board asked him to. CBS News, Reuters and the WSJ cite sources saying the board is not considering it, and Treasury Secretary Bessent wants an outside CEO; results come after the US close today, the first under interim CEO Kress, with analysts expecting about $109B in revenue.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: Q3 results after the close, first under interim CEO
sources: Nvidia, Fox Business, CBS News, Reuters, CNBC, Financial Times

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Bloomberg reported on Sunday that orders are close to seven times the shares on offer, and CNBC cites sources saying the deal will likely price above the $70 to $78 range. Pricing is expected on the evening of Wed 18 Nov, with first trade on Nasdaq as ANT on Thu 19 Nov.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
sources: Anthropic, Bloomberg, CNBC, Yahoo Finance, Reuters

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: Benzinga reports Strategy shares fell about 8% on Mon 16 Nov as bitcoin slid toward $64,000, below the roughly $75,450 average cost in the company's latest 8-K. The MSCI deletion takes effect after the close on 30 Nov, and 24/7 Wall St. cites a JPMorgan estimate of up to $9B in outflows if other index providers follow.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, Benzinga, 24/7 Wall St., CoinDesk, Decrypt

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: Reuters sources say indirect US-Iran talks are stuck on sequencing, with Tehran demanding the US blockade be lifted before substantive talks, and the Iranian and Omani foreign ministers met in Muscat on Tue 17 Nov. OilPrice.com reports near-daily tanker mine incidents in Hormuz, and the US blockade of Iranian ports remains in place.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: Reuters, Oman News Agency, Arab News, OilPrice.com, Gulf News, CoinDesk
